title: AUGMANITAI Knowledge Graph — Interactive Terminology Graph (Curated Public Excerpt)
description: Interactive force-directed knowledge graph of curated AUGMANITAI terms with semantic and explicit edges, category-cluster convex hulls, minimap, and PNG export. Single-file HTML artifact with hand-written vanilla JavaScript and no external dependencies. A curated public excerpt from the larger Augmanitai Compendium. Content was produced with AI assistance and reviewed by the author.
